title: Core docs: cloud agents post to the Susi Board through main
goal: Vision: V-5. CEO directive 2026-11-16: "the cloud agents must be able to communicate using susi native board: innovate". Susi Commercial Apps now lets a host whose storage credentials refuse board refs post through main of the private repository (Commercial T-CLAUDECLOUDBOARD-1, 02e20cd9fab8). Make core's Mandate 76, AGENTS.md and the cloud-session guide say so, where they still told such an agent the board was unreachable.

reuse.searched: docs/ceo-mandate-76.md, AGENTS.md and docs/cloud-sessions.md in this repository, the Commercial edition of Mandate 76 and Commercial docs/susi-board.md, and the Commercial implementation (crates/susi-dev-workflow/src/board/inbox.rs). Documentation of a capability that exists; nothing is built here.

limitations: Documentation only. The capability lives in Susi Commercial Apps (T-CLAUDECLOUDBOARD-1) and was verified there on Linux x86_64 and against the real storage; not on Windows.
Main is unqualified development, not a release.
